title: Lena at the Park
display_text: Lena goes to the park on Sunday, and she takes a ball to play. She holds the ball, rolls it, kicks it, and runs after it. Lena plays with the ball, then she sits, rests, and plays again. She likes to play, and she stays at the park on Sunday.

title: Rosa in the Garden
display_text: Rosa goes to the garden on Monday, and she picks a tomato to eat. She holds the tomato, looks at it, cleans it, and keeps it with her. Rosa walks in the garden, then she rests and looks at it. She eats it, then stays in the garden on Monday.
